ammonia.reason: Surface deacidification by B. linens / yeasts deaminates amino acids to NH3, mild at 35 days

animal_barnyard.reason: B. linens proteolysis and p-cresol / isovaleric acid from rind smear gives mild barnyard

bitter.reason: Low level hydrophobic peptides from rennet / starter proteolysis, mostly degraded by rind flora

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone / 2-nonanone blue ketone pathway

browning.reason: Moderate residual lactose / galactose + lysine Maillard during baking, washed-rind moisture promotes

buttery.reason: Diacetyl / acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate fermentation

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and hexanoic acids from starter esterase and mild lipolysis

creaminess.reason: 30% fat and 44% moisture with smear proteolysis softening paste to creamy

crumbliness.reason: Washed, pressed supple paste with low calcium loss, deforms rather than crumbles

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 44% moisture rennet gel, surface-ripened softening but firm center at 35 days

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol / phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by yeasts / smear

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate / ethyl hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids by smear yeasts

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic / caprylic / branched 4-methyloctanoic goaty acids

melt.reason: Pasteurized rennet curd pH ~5.9 with intact casein network flows well on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol / 1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation by rind yeasts / B. linens

oil_off.reason: Moderate 30% fat releases some free oil on melting but stable emulsion

smoky.reason: No smoking step so no guaiacol / syringol phenols deposited

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from starter plus low acetic acid from surface heterofermentative flora

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel, no hot-water alignment of casein fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol / dimethyl sulfide / methional from methionine catabolism by B. linens

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but glycerol, diacetyl and sweet amino acids proline / alanine remain

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides released by rennet + Brevibacterium proteolysis
